how.title: From X-ray to 10x, in five steps.

xray.label: 1 · X-ray
xray.h3: One day on site. One ranked list.
xray.p: Not a workshop, not a questionnaire. With the people who do the work, we map the process as it really runs, time every station and rank what to fix by payback.

steps.label: 2 · Set the KPIs
steps.p: We set the KPI with you, usually one you already watch. Mate turns it into a metric, a baseline and a deadline.

steps.label: 3 · Build
steps.p: Mate drafts every step inside the ERP, mailbox, WhatsApp and Excel you already use. You approve it before anything goes live.

steps.label: 4 · Measure
steps.p: When the number drifts, Mate shows why and proposes a fix. Estimates stay labeled until your data confirms them.

steps.label: 5 · Improve
steps.p: When no rule covers a case, the person you name decides once, and it stays decided.

faq.title: Questions owners ask.
qs: It stops and asks the person you name. Their answer can become a rule.
What if it makes a mistake?
In a pilot, a person approves every output first. A stop rule, agreed up front, pauses it. Approval steps come off only where the numbers say it is safe.
Do we need a tech team?
No. We build and run it with you, inside the systems you already have.
An X-ray starts at $990. Pilots and processes are priced per process, and part of our fee depends on hitting the number.
